root=Path.cwd(); wheel=root/'dist/ovcaq-0.1.0.dev0-py3-none-any.whl'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ft04r9-installed-config-') as name:
    sandbox=Path(name).resolve(); envroot=sandbox/'env'; project=sandbox/'project';project.mkdir()

    payload='[workflow]\nprd_root = '+'['*2000+'"prds"'+']'*2000+'\n'
